finding: In the canonical final driver, send defaults to RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=30000. session/prompt does not override that timeout. Its Promise is awaited only after the gate registration and resolution polling loops (120s and TTL_MS+60000 respectively, TTL_MS=900000), with no immediate rejection handler. A timeout or early prompt rejection during polling is therefore unhandled rather than propagated through main's try/finally. Default Node unhandled-rejection termination can bypass keyboard deactivation and issuance restore. The prior qualification does not establish this terminal-path guarantee.
